mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (title, content, nickname, password, ip_address, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{nickname}, #{password}, #{ipAddress}, GETDATE(), GETDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, nickname, password, ip_address, created_at, updated_at FROM board ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE id = #{id}
